claim: Reading a variable that is never assigned (and is not a link or built-in) yields null. What happens next is decided by the SLOT: a numeric or boolean slot reads null as 0/false (INFO), any other slot (content, unit, block, link, or the payload of set/print) receives the null OBJECT (ERR).
why: The editor lists every referenced name, so authors sign their work with a bare identifier (`print by:NOSB(hghg`); counting those as errors produced 883 hard errors on a community pack, so signature and comparison cases stay INFO (print-only, printflush without a message block, a set destination never read, punctuation-only names; a null comparison is claimed by constant-null-guard). The rest splits on the slot because LExecutor reads number slots with numi() / bool() (null -> 0, LExecutor.java:634) but hands obj() to every other slot, which then either skips itself (instanceof guard) or writes null onward.
